title: 15-Minute Chickpea and Spinach Shakshuka
intro: This simple, single-skillet meal requires minimal prep and cooks completely on the stovetop. Eggs, chickpeas, and spinach simmer in a spiced tomato sauce for a hearty start to the day.

ingredients.name: No-salt-added canned diced tomatoes
ingredients.canonical_name: Tomatoes, canned, red, diced, low sodium

ingredients.name: No-salt-added canned chickpeas
ingredients.canonical_name: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans), mature seeds, canned, drained, rinsed in tap water

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Stir in garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1 to 2 minutes.
Pour in vinegar, tomatoes, and chickpeas. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat, then lower heat to medium-low and simmer until the sauce thickens slightly, 4 to 5 minutes.
Stir spinach into the skillet in handfuls. Cook until the leaves are bright green and wilted, 1 to 2 minutes.
Form shallow wells in the hot tomato mixture using a spoon. Crack an egg into each well.
Cover the skillet with a lid and cook over low heat until the egg whites are firm but the yolks remain soft, 4 to 6 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the heat. Divide the warm shakshuka between plates and serve immediately with Greek yogurt and pita bread.
variation: Trade the spinach for chopped curly kale and simmer longer.
conservation: Best enjoyed right away; does not keep.
